newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Drilling in Malay-Thai area confirms gas finds.
newsitem.headline: Drilling in Malay-Thai area confirms gas finds.

text.p: Tests on an appraisal well in the Malaysia-Thai Joint Development Area (JDA) have confirmed earlier gas finds in the Muda gas field, a statement by the JDA authority said on Wednesday.
Malaysia's Petronas Carigali (JDA) Sdn Bhd and Thailand's PTTEP International Ltd have completed drilling and testing of the Muda-3 appraisal well, the Malaysia-Thailand Joint Authority said.
The well was drilled to a total depth of 2,944 metres (892 feet) with four drill stem tests conducted at depths ranging from 1,237 metres to 2,887 metres.
The tests yielded a combined stable gas flow rate of 22 million standard cubic feet per day plus 259 barrels a day of condensate of 52-56 degree API, measured through a choke of 52/64 inches.
The two contractors for Blocks B-17 and C-19 have plugged and abandoned the well, the statement said.
